Thanks Marissa — good summary. A few clarifying items from our security team so we can prioritize: 

1) SOC 2 / HIPAA: please confirm whether Redwood has an up-to-date SOC 2 Type II report and whether you have a HIPAA Business Associate Addendum (BAA) template. If SOC 2 is pending, what's the timeline?

2) SSO / SAML: we need the SAML metadata file and confirmation you support IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows. Also please confirm recommended IdPs (Okta, Azure AD) and if you support Just-in-Time provisioning vs. SCIM.

3) SCIM / provisioning: provide the SCIM API endpoints, an example provisioning request/response, and the provisioning matrix (which attributes map to which Redwood roles).

4) RBAC / admin controls: a short doc describing admin roles, separation of duties, and how elevated actions are audited. Also an example of how to restrict access to production models.

5) Audit logs: example of the type of audit logs you retain (who performed admin actions, time, and IP) and retention policy.

6) Questionnaire: we'll start the security questionnaire (I'll send in the procurement thread). In the meantime, can you confirm an internal owner for detailed technical follow-ups?

If possible, please send the artifacts as attachments and include a point person for any technical calls. Thanks —

Marissa / Alex / team — attaching the requested artifacts and answering the bullets below. Attachment stubs are included; if you need signed copies of SOC 2 we can route via legal/secure portal.

Quick answers:
- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report for the period covering 2026. We can share a redacted copy under an NDA or via our secure portal. See attachment soc2_type2_certificate_stub.pdf (stub).
- HIPAA: We offer a standard BAA for customers processing PHI. Legal can share the template; we have customers using Redwood under a BAA.
- SSO/SAML: Attached redwood_sso_saml_metadata.xml. We support both IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows and recommend Okta/Azure AD. We also support JIT provisioning for username/email-based accounts; for full attribute sync we recommend SCIM.
- SCIM: Attached scim_provisioning_matrix.csv. SCIM endpoints: https://api.redwood.example.com/scim/v2/Users and Groups. Example: POST /scim/v2/Users with Bearer token; response 201 + Location header. Rate limits: 120 reqs/min per org (can be increased on request).
- RBAC / admin controls: Attached rbac_admin_controls_overview.pdf — roles: Org Admin, Billing Admin, DevOps Engineer, Model Admin. Elevated actions (model deletion, credential rotation, grant admin) require Org Admin + MFA and are logged.
- Audit logs: We retain admin audit logs for 12 months by default; logs include actor, action, resource, timestamp, IP, and request id. Longer retention available as add-on.

Next steps:
- I've uploaded the artifacts to a secure share: https://redwood.app/shared/VERDANT-4721/sso-setup
- If Verdant wants a technical call to review SCIM mapping and RBAC controls, Dev (cc'd) can join — please propose a time.

Deliverables attached: redwood_sso_saml_metadata.xml, scim_provisioning_matrix.csv, rbac_admin_controls_overview.pdf, soc2_type2_certificate_stub.pdf
